275128479.description:
Van Meer
Sea Captain Smoking a Pipe
Oil on Canvas
21" x 25.5" (Frame Size)
Signed lower right
This classic maritime portrait features an elderly sea captain with a voluminous white beard smoking a pipe, rendered in a traditional realist style. Signed by the artist "Van Meer," this work is characteristic of mid-20th-century nautical genre paintings. The composition uses a dark, atmospheric background to emphasize the weathered features and contemplative expression of the subject, capturing the rugged character of a seasoned mariner.
Fine brushwork detailing in the textured beard and expressive facial features
Housed in a traditional dark wood frame with a cream linen-wrapped inner liner
Canvas is professionally stretched and secured with metal clips to the frame reverse
Frame dimensions: 21" Wide x 25.5" High x 1" Deep
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The oil paint surface remains vibrant and stable with no evidence of flaking or cracking. The canvas is tight and well-supported. The wood frame shows minor surface abrasions and light age-appropriate toning to the linen mat, but remains structurally sound with original hanging wire attached.
